slot_count.description: Number of slots in this commitment.
slot_count.rationale: This mainly controls performance/capacity and does not change access control, permissions, or encryption settings.

plan.rationale: This decides the commitment plan type but it does not directly affect security settings like IAM or data protection.

renewal_plan.description: The plan this capacity commitment is converted to after the commitment end time passes.
renewal_plan.rationale: This is only related to billing/plan rollover and does not change access permissions or security controls.

edition.description: The edition type. Valid values are STANDARD, ENTERPRISE, ENTERPRISE_PLUS.
edition.rationale: This controls the product edition level but does not directly change security settings such as encryption or access.

capacity_commitment_id.description: Optional capacity commitment ID. If not set, the name will be generated automatically.
capacity_commitment_id.rationale: This is just a naming/identifier field and does not impact security or access to the resource.

location.description: The geographic location where the capacity commitment should reside (for example: US, EU, asia-northeast1).
location.rationale: Location must be restricted to approved regions to support data residency and compliance requirements.

enforce_single_admin_project_per_org.description: If true, fail the request if another project in the organization has a capacity commitment.
enforce_single_admin_project_per_org.rationale: This is more of an organisation/admin control to avoid conflicts, but it does not directly change access control or security settings.

project.description: If it is not provided, the provider project is used.
project.rationale: This only tells Terraform what project to use and does not automatically change security settings by itself.
